hypothesis: P60-1 entry-state restriction is local and directional
test: Compare real paragraph line0->line2 transitions with all eligible internal pseudo-start i->i+2 transitions (i>=1). Paragraphs are paired where at least one pseudo-transition exists. Generic 11-feature EVA line fingerprint; no semantic labels used.

anti_circular_leaf_holdout.method: 5 folds by physical leaf; learn real-entry direction on training leaves only, compare real vs internal pseudo boundaries on held-out leaves

decision: P60-1 SURVIVES. Matched internal pseudo-boundaries do not reproduce the real paragraph-entry transition. The effect remains positive in every physical-leaf held-out fold, so it is not merely circular estimation of the transition direction.
interpretation: The item-initialization narrative passes its first direct falsification attempt: the transition is specifically concentrated at true paragraph starts rather than being a generic two-line fluctuation anywhere inside paragraphs.
cautions: This 60A implementation uses a rebuilt generic EVA 11-feature line fingerprint and therefore is a direct entry-specificity test, not yet the exact Phase59C Latin-orthogonal projection replication.
Paragraph length constrains which internal pseudo-starts exist; later tests should position-match and length-match pseudo-boundaries.
Survival of P60-1 is structural evidence only.
next: 60B feature attribution and representation robustness, followed by stricter position/length-matched pseudo-boundary controls.
